common_policy.receptor_mutations: back-mutate every deposited receptor mutation to the UniProt residue before MD
common_policy.internal_missing_segments: model and validate; reject knots, clashes, cis peptide artifacts, and chirality errors
common_policy.terminal_missing_segments: do not model unless required for a transmembrane helix or declared contact; cap the resolved construct termini
common_policy.sidechain_completion: rebuild all missing heavy atoms before protonation
common_policy.retained_water_rule: retain deposited waters within 5.0 A of the native ligand or retained sodium ion; record residue IDs before dynamics
common_policy.removed_solvent_rule: remove detergents, crystallization additives, and bulk crystallographic solvent
validation_required: all selected residues have standard L chirality
no severe steric clashes after repair
all peptide bonds and disulfides are valid
no modeled loop knot or membrane-spanning artifact
native ligand remains in the deposited pose before minimization
all coordinate, topology, parameter, and decision files are hashed

remove_components: deposited cholesterol molecules before rebuilding the standardized membrane
retain_components: waters passing the common retained-water rule
5NM4_ZMA_native.special_risk: S277A is a deposited orthosteric mutation and must be restored before native-contact enumeration.

5G53_NECA_miniGs_native.mini_gs_policy: retain the engineered mini-Gs sequence and mutations exactly; model only internal missing engineered segments
5G53_NECA_miniGs_native.gdp_policy: include GDP by rigidly transferring GDP C 400 into the selected D-chain nucleotide pocket using shared mini-Gs backbone atoms; report alignment RMSD and reject clashes
5G53_NECA_miniGs_native.gdp_basis: The deposited asymmetric unit contains GDP only in chain C; the published 5G53 mini-Gs MD precedent selected chains B/D and included GDP.
remove_components: all components belonging only to chains A/C except the aligned GDP source coordinates

membrane_and_solvent.orientation: OPM/PPM orientation with membrane normal along Z; store the orientation transform

tool_boundary.preferred_builder: CHARMM-GUI PDB Reader plus GalaxyFill and Membrane Builder
tool_boundary.reason: The controls contain internal missing segments, an engineered fusion, a mini-Gs complex, and a mixed POPC/cholesterol membrane; these require visual and topology validation beyond automatic PDBFixer output.
tool_boundary.pdbfixer_role: inventory and independent missing-atom checks only; do not accept its long-loop coordinates without human structural review
